description: Spacious and generous. Well-lit throughout. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Clear functional corridor connecting zones. Kitchen: L-shaped or U-shaped with extended counter run, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. Two cooks can work simultaneously on separate counter runs. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Two sofas in the upper-right living zone arranged around a central coffee table facing the TV on the upper wall; dining table with 6 seats to the right side near windows.. Dining table (6 seats). TV on wall opposite wall to entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor, 15 m² — large enough for bunk beds. Secondary bedroom 2 — accessed via own door off corridor, 15 m² — large enough for bunk beds. Each single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 0 of 2 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room / home office + children's bedroom simultaneously / bunk bed setup in the larger room — two children sharing, other bedroom freed as dedicated office or hobby space. Storage: no wardrobe — very limited storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet). Two bathrooms — two people can shower simultaneously, parallel morning and evening routines possible. Suits: families with two or more children; multi-generational households; families wanting two children sharing one large bedroom (bunk beds), keeping the other bedroom as a dedicated office or hobby space. Not suitable for: households needing ample storage — the layout has no wardrobes or dedicated storage rooms; remote workers needing a dedicated home office or desk space, as no desks are visible in bedrooms; anyone requiring a guest WC separate from the bathrooms.
